_meta.notes: Colorado General Assembly roster: 35 Senate + 65 House = 100 seats, all filled as of 2026-07-25. This file is NOT a collection source. Every entry has collection_method=null because no Colorado legislator publishes a per-member pressroom; see co_legislature.json for the four caucus sources that carry all press output. Use this roster for named-entity attribution against caucus release bodies and for the member directory UI. Emails are the official published legislator inboxes from the .gov roster, not press-secretary addresses.
